4395 exts_i = (char **) malloc((num_exts_i + 1) * (sizeof *exts_i));
4396 if (exts_i == NULL) {
4397 return 0;
4398 }
4399 for(index = 0; index < num_exts_i; index++) {
4400 const char *gl_str_tmp = (const char*) glad_glGetStringi(GL_EXTENSIONS, index);
4401 size_t len = strlen(gl_str_tmp) + 1;
4402
4403 char *local_str = (char*) malloc(len * sizeof(char));
4404 if(local_str == NULL) {
4405 exts_i[index] = NULL;
4406 glad_gl_free_extensions(exts_i);
4407 return 0;
4408 }
4409
4410 memcpy(local_str, gl_str_tmp, len * sizeof(char));
4411 exts_i[index] = local_str;
4412 }
4413 exts_i[index] = NULL;
4414
4415 *out_exts_i = exts_i;
4416
4417 return 1;
4418 }
4419#else
4420 GLAD_UNUSED(out_exts_i);
4421#endif
4422 if (glad_glGetString == NULL) {
4423 return 0;
4424 }
4425 *out_exts = (const char *)glad_glGetString(GL_EXTENSIONS);
4426 return 1;
4427}
4428static int glad_gl_has_extension(const char *exts, char **exts_i, const char *ext) {
4429 if(exts_i) {
4430 unsigned int index;
4431 for(index = 0; exts_i[index]; index++) {
4432 const char *e = exts_i[index];
4433 if(strcmp(e, ext) == 0) {
4434 return 1;
4435 }
4436 }
4437 } else {
4438 const char *extensions;
4439 const char *loc;
4440 const char *terminator;
4441 extensions = exts;
4442 if(extensions == NULL || ext == NULL) {
4443 return 0;
4444 }
4445 while(1) {
4446 loc = strstr(extensions, ext);
4447 if(loc == NULL) {
4448 return 0;
4449 }
4450 terminator = loc + strlen(ext);
4451 if((loc == extensions || *(loc - 1) == ' ') &&
4452 (*terminator == ' ' || *terminator == '\0')) {
4453 return 1;
4454 }
4455 extensions = terminator;
4456 }
4457 }
4458 return 0;
4459}

4551static int glad_gl_find_core_gl(void) {
4552 int i;
4553 const char* version;
4554 const char* prefixes[] = {
4555 "OpenGL ES-CM ",
4556 "OpenGL ES-CL ",
4557 "OpenGL ES ",
4558 "OpenGL SC ",
4559 NULL
4560 };
4561 int major = 0;
4562 int minor = 0;
4563 version = (const char*) glad_glGetString(GL_VERSION);
4564 if (!version) return 0;
4565 for (i = 0; prefixes[i]; i++) {
4566 const size_t length = strlen(prefixes[i]);
4567 if (strncmp(version, prefixes[i], length) == 0) {
4568 version += length;
4569 break;
4570 }
4571 }
4572
4573 GLAD_IMPL_UTIL_SSCANF(version, "%d.%d", &major, &minor);
4574
4575 GLAD_GL_VERSION_1_0 = (major == 1 && minor >= 0) || major > 1;
4576 GLAD_GL_VERSION_1_1 = (major == 1 && minor >= 1) || major > 1;
4577 GLAD_GL_VERSION_1_2 = (major == 1 && minor >= 2) || major > 1;
4578 GLAD_GL_VERSION_1_3 = (major == 1 && minor >= 3) || major > 1;
4579 GLAD_GL_VERSION_1_4 = (major == 1 && minor >= 4) || major > 1;
4580 GLAD_GL_VERSION_1_5 = (major == 1 && minor >= 5) || major > 1;
4581 GLAD_GL_VERSION_2_0 = (major == 2 && minor >= 0) || major > 2;
4582 GLAD_GL_VERSION_2_1 = (major == 2 && minor >= 1) || major > 2;
4583 GLAD_GL_VERSION_3_0 = (major == 3 && minor >= 0) || major > 3;
4584 GLAD_GL_VERSION_3_1 = (major == 3 && minor >= 1) || major > 3;
4585 GLAD_GL_VERSION_3_2 = (major == 3 && minor >= 2) || major > 3;
4586 GLAD_GL_VERSION_3_3 = (major == 3 && minor >= 3) || major > 3;
4587
4588 return GLAD_MAKE_VERSION(major, minor);
4589}
